claims.wording: We can build a prospect-specific AI receptionist demo before you decide whether to buy.
limitations: Demo behavior is based only on observed business facts supplied to the builder.
Production deployment, phone connectivity, pricing, and service commitments require a separately approved contract.

limitations: Gate A demonstrations are synthetic only.
No real phone call or customer contact is enabled before Gate B.
